progress.summary: Execute approved R3 via run-contract.kp.bayesian-flagship-v2 until s09 visual acceptance; R1 R2 complete.

allowedWork: The semantic reader matches the accepted x + 3 = 7 animation card at named forward and reverse frames without typography changes, collisions, or discontinuities.
Motion communicates algebraic causality while prose, static HTML, search, print, precise URLs, and accessible focus remain first-class.
The accepted visual runtime lives behind neutral renderer contracts that the editor and reader can share without coupling either surface to the other.
A visible motion policy preserves essential semantic motion under reduced-motion preferences and retains an explicit static option.
Human visual approval of the gold equation exemplar is required before the architecture is generalized to other asset families.
disallowedWork: Preserve the semantic asset model, reader compiler, continuous scroll clock, exact rewind, URL restoration, static and no-JavaScript output, searchability, printability, and current editor behavior.
Do not import editor code into the reader; extract accepted behavior into neutral rendering modules with inferred TypeScript APIs.
Do not generalize to missing-middle, graphs, diagrams, code, networks, providers, flashcards, WebGL, FTC, economics, or physics before the gold equation exemplar passes human visual review.
Keep the exemplar rollback independently reversible to the shared equation visual renderer and reader adapter.
Avoid Three.js, WebGL, client-side KaTeX, or unrelated bundle growth on the equation reader route.
